lessons.trigger_condition: V382 can gate long-horizon drift and neural calibration, but it does not independently learn a compact verified-outcome neural policy online, retain regime-conditioned action memory, reduce optional learning under resource pressure, detect operational change points, or promote self-composed allowlisted capabilities through shadow-canary-active rollback states.
lessons.prevention_rule: V385 must train only a bounded 14x8x1 device-local neural policy from verified V381/V382 outcome aggregates, condition scoring on operational market regime without inferring direction, detect KPI/drift change points, schedule optional learning from verified resource headroom, self-compose only allowlisted declarative capability primitives through shadow-canary-active states with KPI rollback, and emit source-level gaps only as non-executable protected-PR/CI plans while V382/V381 remain mandatory hard gates.
validation_required: watched paths are main, tablet_autonomous_evolution_v385.py and tablet_runtime_manifest.py
tablet runtime manifest includes v385 while preserving v382 through v376
online neural training ignores candidates below the verified sample threshold
market adaptation is regime-conditioned operational adaptation only and never predicts market direction
resource-low mode disables optional meta/capability/skill work while preserving bounded safe execution permission
capability self-extension uses only fixed allowlisted declarative primitives
new capability recipes must progress shadow to canary to active and roll back on verified KPI regression
source-level new functions remain non-executable plans requiring protected PR/CI, regression, integrity, alignment and actual-output validation
V382 or earlier hard holds cannot be overridden
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V385 expands autonomous learning and safe declarative self-extension only; it never generates or rewrites source code, executes arbitrary commands, writes Git/main, weakens verification, auto-promotes trust/facts/prices/grades, predicts market direction, or claims physical-device success without evidence.
